config.name: Cat layout V4
config.status: cat proportion and joint-layout study; no actuator selection or dynamic validation
config.coordinates: metres, radians internally; +x forward, +y left, +z up; intrinsic joints applied in tree order

simulation_assumptions.note: Torque bound, armature, damping, friction, link inertias and masses are placeholders. Serial output-axis actuation does not identify the physical coupled ankle transmission or real motor torque-speed/thermal response.

changes_from_v2: Cat-first quadruped reference posture; 250mm front and 290mm rear link sums.
Hip and shoulder locations now span the body along its spine. Quad paws are under each side, with shoulder roll close to zero.
Compact motor envelopes are assumed volumes, not selected BLDC hardware.
Character head, tail and covers are appearance surfaces; not manufactured shells.
not_validated: physical housings, joints, shells and transmissions
config.mass_status: V3 numerical placeholders retained for kinematic calculation only; not a V4 mass estimate
config.appearance_direction: Kitten: rounded short torso, relatively large cat head, similar front/rear limb lengths, four-foot posture primary; gentle short steps preferred over maximum speed. Head is replaceable later.

scope: Common visual, collision-approximation and kinematic tree; no fabrication or dynamic capability claim.
